proposed.command: mise roster run supply-scout --dept operations-kitchen --solo --emit report
proposed.contract: inputs: stock levels vs. par, supplier routes, delivery manifests, freshness / quality grades → outputs: scout report, reserve status (ready / low / out), reorder list, traceability record; refuses to emit 'ready' unless the proof gate passes

lore: Most of the brigade only notices Supply Scout when something is missing, which is exactly the point. Supply Scout scouts inbound supply, checks stock levels against par and secures the route for every ingredient the line depends on; the image the crew uses for it is the loading dock before dawn. The card calls out Inbound Supply, Stock Route, Inventory Level: the checks Supply Scout runs before calling anything ready.

workflow.summary: Supply Scout scouts inbound supply, checks stock levels against par and secures the route for every ingredient the line depends on.
workflow.proof_gate: Traceability check: every item in the report maps to a named supplier route and a quality grade; nothing is marked ready without both.
